name: nr-headline-words-v1
frozenBefore: any news headline was read or printed (the downloads print counts only)
base: event-swing's pre-registered guidance lists (strategy/event-swing/classifier-v1.json, commit 3a0589f), applied to the headline as one sentence
extension: headline words added on 2026-11-06 before any headline was read; matched as whole lower-case words

rule.negative: the headline holds a guidance noun and a lower word, or any negative word
rule.positive: not negative, and the headline holds a guidance noun and a raise word, or any positive word
rule.precedence: negative wins over positive (the conservative reading)
rule.use: configuration DC only: an item classified negative disarms the bullish scenario of its plan; nothing else changes

never: a person or a language model reads or classifies a headline for this rule
